All displayed reproductive estimates and prediction curves use maximum likelihood. Clutch-size curves use 4,000 joint asymptotic coefficient draws and fledging curves use 8,000; both retain cross-component covariance. Bands are pointwise 95% CIs, not intervals for individual broods. Other continuous predictors are centred and random effects are zero. These are adjusted associations rather than observed historical trajectories.
